doc: stages/filters.hag_nn.rst Example #3: 'If you don't yet have points classified as ground, start with :ref:`filters.pmf` or :ref:`filters.smrf` to label ground returns' followed by filters.hag_nn and filters.ferry ``HeightAboveGround=>Z``. terrain.las is a sloped plane (1600 pts) plus a 6x6 block at +8 m and a 4x4 block at +3 m; after ground labelling by filters.csf the HAG of the blocks is exactly 8 and 3, ground is 0.
